definitions.gloss: same age, of the same age
definitions.explanation: Being born in the same year; having the same age as someone else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同|おな}い{年|どし}だ。
{同|おな}い{年|どし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧。
examples.english: A friend of the same age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同|おな}い{年|どし}らしい。
examples.english: Apparently he and she are the same age.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}い{年|どし}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{親近感|しんきんかん}→親近感：19224_shinkinkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わいた。
examples.english: I felt a sense of closeness when I learned we were the same age.

notes:
{同|おな}い{年|どし} means being the same age.

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the unusual reading お⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ for {同|おな}い, which only appears in this word.

USAGE:
Commonly used when discovering someone shares your birth year, often creating a sense of connection or equality.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {同|おな}い{年|どし}だ: to be the same age
- {同|おな}い{年|どし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: of the same age (attributive)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, discovering someone is {同|おな}い{年|どし} often shifts the relationship dynamic, as age-based hierarchies (⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧/⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧) become less relevant.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{同年代|どうねんだい}→同年代：22399_dounendai⟧: same generation
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: same year (school/work entry)
- タメ: same age (casual slang)
